title: Research MCP gateway used port 8011 instead of AIstock backend 8001
description:
Expected: Research MCP gateway connects to the AIstock backend on port 8001 and can serve research_pipeline API requests.
Actual: backend/mcp/gateway.py and .mcp.json used port 8011 while the AIstock backend was running on 8001, causing Research MCP calls to fail with connection refused.
This was fixed before this registry cleanup; this record was renumbered to remove a duplicate BUG ID.

events.note: Fix committed in worktree F:/Dev/AIstock_worktrees/bug-097-mcp-gateway-port-fix, branch bug-097-mcp-gateway-port-fix. Changes: gateway.py DEFAULT_BASE_URL 8011→8001, .mcp.json comment + AISTOCK_MCP_BASE_URL 8011→8001. 同步修复了用户全局 ~/.mcp.json。等待用户确认后合入 main。
Merged bug-097-mcp-gateway-port-fix into main (ort strategy, 2 files changed). Worktree cleanup pending. 用户需重启 Claude Code 使 ~/.mcp.json 修改生效。
